description: Page through Mappit's stories for a place, a country or the whole world, newest first (or sort "trending" for Mappit's ranking). Use for "all the news from Kyiv this week", "more stories" after whats_happening, or stories on one topic. Filters: time window, topic, language, and source "crawler" for stories Mappit's own crawler read from the publishers. Returns a cursor for the next page. To find stories by words or meaning, use search_mappit.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, exactly as returned.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, or omit for every language.

limit.description: Stories per page: default 20, at most 50.

place.description: Where: a place name, place id, country, US state or "lat,lon". Omit for the whole world.

source.description: "any" (default) or "crawler" (only stories Mappit's crawler read from the publishers themselves).

topic.description: A topic slug or name ("science", "World & Conflict"); several separated by commas.

window.description: How far back: "24h", "72h", "7d" or "30d" (any number of hours or days up to 30 days). Default: 72h, as in whats_happening.

name: list_stories
title: List stories
